visual_appeal: Paint the hero '1.7' in warm gold #F0D090 at the same size, not cyan, so it shares the bronze/cream material of the title and bars.
Soften the row state chips: 20px tall, 1px #000000 inset, label 11px; they currently shout louder than the portrait and name.
Add a 1px inner highlight #6A5030 along the top of the hero only, so the panel has the slight depth of the character frame rather than a flat fill.
character_identity: List-row portraits are muddy at ~28px. Crop them 1:1 at 36px with a 1px ring #8A7040 and 8px gap before the name.

The welcome Jacques portrait is a class emblem, not a face. Use the same 72px circular crop and gold ring as Le Nette, or if no portrait exists show a 64px ring labelled with the race, not a red crest that does not match the other heads.
On the card, drop the speech bubble 4px so its tail points at the portrait, and keep the bubble max width 280px so two-line jokes do not crowd the level line.
default_theme: Hero #2A2118 still reads near-black beside ElvUI. Lift the hero to #3A2C1E, the list well to #2A2018, and row alternates to #32261C / #3A2E22 so the inn brown is obvious at a glance.
Header bronze rule is easy to miss. Make it 2px #8A6840, inset 12px, with 8px space under it before the hero.
The Link account button on first-run is a flat grey slab. Use the bronze bevel (fill #6E5428, top #C4A36A, bottom #3A2A14) at 140x26 with 13px cream label.
elvui_wc3_fit: Match the character window corners: 8px bronze studs #8C7350 at each corner of the main frame and the card, on a 1px #2A241C outer border, not a plain gold stroke.
Compact is the right blue enamel, but View Le Nette is a flat red rectangle. Give it the same bevel as Expanded Stats: top #C45048, fill #8E2E2A, bottom #4A1614, 14px cream, height 26px.
ElvUI wells should stay #12100E. Do not reuse the warm default row tint; alternate #161310 and #1C1914 only, or the two themes still feel like one list.
alerts_ux: The logout View Le Nette button reads green and collides with the FULL chip. Use the Esc-strip bronze bevel, 150x28, fill #6E5428, top edge #C4A36A, label 14px #F3E6C8, and put 10px between it and the 20px FULL chip.

Keep one type ramp on both alerts: headline 14px semibold #F3E6C8, body 12px #C8B89A. Logout body stays 'Cancel the logout, then hearth to Crossroads or reach an inn.' Esc body stays the shorter line, same sizes.
Gear is a 12px speck. Draw it 16px, hit target 24px, 8px left of the X, so Alert settings is actually findable.
readability: Meta under the hero name ('Brill inn · seen 4d ago') is below 12px. Set it to 12px #D9CBB2 with 4px line gap.
Compact tooltip state column: yellow 'Nearly full' at #E6C15A fails on #1A140E. Use #F0D48A, 12px, and keep names at 13px.
Now-playing 'none used this session' and '0.6 rested levels left' should be 12px #E4D5B8, not a dim 10px under the bar.
layout_polish: 'Le Bankken' plus 'Acct #3' collide. Put the account tag 6px after the name at 11px #A89880, or drop it under the level line.
Right column is busy (percent, time, chip). Fix the chip column at 108px, the time column at 120px right-aligned, and keep 12px between the bar end and the percent.
First-run step rows need 10px between icon and text and 14px between steps; the parchment icons currently sit tight against the numbers.
delight: The moon in the title is static. Fill it in 4 steps with the top character's rested fraction (empty, quarter, half, full) in #F0D090 so the header itself says who is ready.
Give the card portrait a 2px #C4A36A ring and keep the small '22' badge, but move 'zzz' to 12px above the ring in #E8D7A8 so it does not sit in the bubble's corner.
The ran-out toast is one flat line. Set 'Play Le Nette' in 14px #F3E6C8 and '1.7 levels banked' in 13px #8FCB6A on the green rail so the reward reads before the dismiss X.

overall_notes: The roster logic is clear and the speech lines do real character work. I would not ship it to a picky ElvUI user yet: the Gatewood frame is still a plain dark box, the logout action button reads as a green status chip, and the default inn brown is only a shade warmer than ElvUI black.
